stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

## Task family: broken horizontal bars + vertical stems (task-b873b454)

Observed rule from two demos and verified test:
- A grid contains one or more horizontal bars, each with one-cell gaps (sometimes two adjacent horizontal color groups with separate gaps), plus vertical stem(s) lower in the grid.
- Extend each horizontal bar through its missing cell(s).
- Each gap is also the column of a vertical line. The horizontal bar's color fills that column from the bar toward the nearest horizontal bar above (stopping at its row), or the top edge if none. Repeating this between each horizontal bar produces vertical column segments colored by the horizontal bar at the lower end of each interval.
- Below the lowest horizontal row, extend the pre-existing vertical stem color upward to that row; the stem remains that color below the horizontal bar to the bottom edge.
- At a horizontal intersection, that bar fills the gap cell with its own color. All other cells stay 0 / retain original colored bars and stems.

Evidence:
- Demo 1: row 9 had color-2 left and color-3 right with gaps at c3/c9; these were filled, with c3=2 and c9=3 extended up to top. Existing stems below were c3=3 and c9=4, extended upward to row 10.

- Test task-b873b454 solved with c3 row segments: rows0-2=2, row3-6=3, row7-11=4, rows12+=6; c8 segments rows0-3=5, rows4-8=9, rows9-11=4, rows12+=8. Horizontal gaps filled accordingly.
